target_customer: Computer vision teams that need labeled training data
problem: Collecting and labeling real images for computer vision is slow, costly and raises bias and privacy issues.
business_model: Synthetic training data as a service

competitors.name: AI.Reverie
competitors.funding_then: Over $10M total after a $5.6M round led by Vulcan Capital in April 2020

competitors.name: Cvedia
competitors.what: Synthetic data and simulators for computer vision
competitors.funding_then: Corporate minority round from FLIR in 2018, amount undisclosed

technical_complexity.rationale: Cloud rendering of synthetic scenes plus matching the domain gap to real data is hard but known.

defensibility.rationale: Rendering pipelines were replicable and funded rivals existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Facebook bought AI.Reverie in 2021 per VentureBeat via search; no source on Zumo.

market_need_then: YC page cites cost, bias and privacy problems of manual data collection; synthetic data funding rose in 2020 to 2021.

branding.domain_note: Site zumolabs.ai returned 404 in this session.

brand_strength.rationale: Several unrelated companies use Zumo; no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Zumo Labs was a seven person synthetic computer vision data company with a $150K YC era entry in databases. YC lists it as inactive, one CB Insights page says ceased operations and another comparison page says acquired, and no press confirms either, so the cause and exit are not public. Funded rivals such as AI.Reverie and Parallel Domain were ahead.
notes: The $150K round rests on CB Insights, Seedtable and Bouncewatch (which also names TGM Ventures and labels it pre-seed). CB Insights conflicts on exit (ceased operations vs acquired); neither verified, so exit is unknown. Parallel Domain and Datagen are dated after the batch and not listed. zumolabs.ai guess returned 404; the real site was not found. Education and employers not found.
